cases.situation: My neighbour Mrs. Alvarez watered my plants and fed my cat Pepper for 2 weeks while I was in Portugal. She left a little note saying Pepper slept on her lap. I want to leave a card with some pastéis de nata I brought back.
cases.reply: Dear Mrs. Alvarez, thank you so much for looking after Pepper and the plants for two whole weeks. Your note about Pepper napping on your lap made me laugh, she clearly had a better holiday than I did. These pastéis are from a little bakery in Lisbon I think you'd love. Please let me return the favour whenever you're away. Warmly, Clara
cases.note: One concrete detail she couldn't have guessed you'd mention, and a forward line.

cases.situation: 结婚的时候我大学导师随了2000块红包，还专门从外地赶过来参加婚礼。想给他发条微信好好谢谢。
cases.reply: 陈老师，谢谢您专程从成都赶来参加我们的婚礼，看到您坐在台下的时候我特别感动。您的红包我们打算用来买一台一直想要的咖啡机，以后每天早上都会想起您。等您下次来杭州，我们请您来家里吃饭。
cases.note: 礼金不提数目，说用来做什么；重点谢他这个人和他跑的这一趟。

cases.situation: My old manager Denise wrote me a reference 4 months ago and I got the job. I completely forgot to thank her and I feel awful.
cases.reply: Hi Denise, this is embarrassingly late, but I didn't want it to go unsaid: thank you for the reference in June. I got the role at Harlow and I've just finished my first quarter leading the analytics team. A lot of how I run my team comes from watching you run ours. Coffee next time I'm back in Leeds?
cases.note: One clause of ownership for the lateness, then the thanks. No paragraph of apology.
